# ataila_k8s_clusters (Data Source)

The Kubernetes clusters projects can run on, by name, the disabled ones included. No endpoint or address.

Needs `infrastructure-read-global`; never readable with a tenant-scoped token. Platform release 1.0.400 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The clusters a Kubernetes project can be homed on.
data "ataila_k8s_clusters" "all" {}

output "targetable_clusters" {
  value = [for c in data.ataila_k8s_clusters.all.clusters : c.name if c.targetable]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes List) The clusters, by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `default_for_envs` (List of String) The environments a project that names no cluster runs here.
- `enabled` (Boolean) False while projects may not use it.
- `is_default_home` (Boolean) True for the cluster a project lands on when it names none.
- `name` (String) The cluster's name: what a Kubernetes project names as its target.
- `single_node` (Boolean) True for a one-node cluster.
- `targetable` (Boolean) True when a project may be homed here.
- `tenant_gpu_cards` (Number) GPU cards it offers to tenants' workloads.
- `whole_project` (Boolean) True when a project targeted here has every environment on it.
